text:
alex: Heads up: landing in LHR next Thurs, only have 45 mins between meetings. Any speedy spots near Paddington station for a decent sandwich/salad? Prefer veggie options.

jamie: Try 'Gail's' on Stroud Green? Wait, wrong city lol. For Paddington specifically, 'Heka' does warm bowls and fast takeaway. 3-5min from the station.

priya: 'The Mad Bishop & Bear' is pub-y but they do good sandwiches and will box up quickly. Also close to the station.

ben: If you can step a bit toward Praed St, 'Pret A Manger' or 'Itsu' are predictably fast for salads. Not exciting but reliable.

karen: Quick hack: order via Deliveroo pickup and choose ASAP, then run in and grab it yourself to save queue time. Works well at Pret.

alex: Love the Deliveroo idea. Anyone tried Heka's falafel bowl (is it filling)?

priya: Yes, Heka's falafel bowl is tasty and filling — ask for extra hummus. They also label allergens.

jamie: Also FYI Paddington station has a sandwich kiosk that's annoyingly small but super quick if you're in a real rush.

alex: Plan set: land, sprint to Paddington, Deliveroo pickup at Pret if Heka long. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:
